text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run her race to the end, Sakura 
Chiyono O began to discover her own 
challenges and weapons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To win her dream race, the Derby, she 
decided to enter the next GⅠ of equal 
prestige, the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and Mejiro Ardan heard that 
story directly from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki then told Sakura Chiyono O 
that she wanted to see the moment her 
"eyes bared their fangs," announcing that 
she would come watch the Asahi Hai FS.
